disposition_reason: Tables 3 and 4 print per-sample major and trace elements, including lead and cadmium, for 15 honeys (8 local, 7 branded market samples) from Sindh, with ranges and means.

study.design: Survey of local and branded honey
study.origin: local honey from countryside areas of Sindh, Pakistan; branded (imported) honey varieties
study.market: seven samples purchased from the local market, Hyderabad, Sindh
study.method: HNO3/H2O2 hot-plate digestion of 5 g; flame AAS (PerkinElmer AA-800), triplicate
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or detection limits reported
